faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How long does it take to install a solar system?
faq.answer1: Installation typically takes 1 to 3 days for residential systems, depending on size and complexity.
faq.question2: What maintenance is required for solar panels?
faq.answer2: Solar panels require minimal maintenance, mainly occasional cleaning to ensure optimal efficiency.
faq.question3: Do I get a warranty for the system?
faq.answer3: Yes, we offer warranties for both the panels and the inverter, as well as for the installation itself. You will receive details with your quote.
